trigger_condition: Local/global config has explicit "workspace": null left by a hand-edit
guard_snippet: if (config.workspace != null) return config; // match resolveWorkspace()'s null semantics
potential_consequence: Migration treats null as already-migrated, skipping cleanup of stale per-profile fields

trigger_condition: workspace field is a non-null non-object (array, string, number) from a hand-edited config
potential_consequence: Malformed workspace value passed through as defined and merged into config via Object.assign

trigger_condition: Local multi-provider config file changes between the two sequential loadLocalMultiProviderConfig() reads
guard_snippet: const localWorkspaceScope = await this.loadLocalMultiProviderConfig(workingDir); const workspace = localWorkspaceScope.workspace != null ? localWorkspaceScope.workspace : (await this.loadMultiProviderConfig()).workspace ?? {};
potential_consequence: workspaceSource label can disagree with the actually-resolved workspace object under concurrent writes
